summary: Generates a noise value approximating a normal distribution: popcount of a 32-bit hash-based PRNG result gives a binomial term, combined with a noise-table float at the auto-incremented index, centered and scaled by 0.35355338 (~1/sqrt(8)). On the per-frame random/audio/noise path.

operations.description: v2 = DeterministicHashPseudoRandomGenerator(this); hash-based PRNG feeding popcount and table index
for i in 0..31: v3 += (v2 >> i) & 1; popcount of v2 as binomial distribution term
v5 = *(float *)&this[(unsigned __int8)(*this)++ + 257] * 0.5; read noise-table float, advance stored index
result = (v5 + (double)(v3 - 16)) * 0.35355338; center the binomial term and apply final scale
